title: 计费改正，组员其余原样
kept_reason: 基准。计费已按题意改正，其余思路与组员一致。后续每一块优化都相对这一版（或当时的 champion）比总费用。

evaluation.price_source: 附件1, same daily tariff for Q3
evaluation.pv_forecast_source: 附件3, issued at 0/6/12/18, 24 hourly points ahead
evaluation.january_role: forecast history only, not in reported cost

billing.emergency: 5p × shortage after purchase + battery vs actual net
billing.spill: unused surplus is discarded, prepaid purchase is not refunded
billing.note: This is the only intentional change vs the teammate notebook. Her LP used +0.5p on downward so the optimizer never cancelled.

assumptions: Each calendar day is an independent problem: SOC at 0:00 = SOC at 24:00 = 6000 kWh. Storage does not carry overnight.
The 00:00 plan quantity is the contract baseline for the whole day. Default/extra fees are always vs that baseline, not vs the previous update.
Purchase contracts cannot be changed every 10 minutes. Updates are allowed only when PV forecasts are issued (0/6/12/18).
At 6:00 / 12:00 / 18:00 the code re-solves only the next ~6-hour block, not the entire remaining day.
End-of-block SOC is pinned to the 00:00 planned SOC so blocks can be switched on/off independently.
After a block is locked, battery charge/discharge follows the scheduled values. No real-time recourse when actual load/PV differs.
Shortage after locked purchase + scheduled battery is emergency at 5p. Surplus is spilled.
The LP meets padded net-load, not actual net-load. Emergency cost is not in the optimizer objective.
Among the 8 update subsets, the reported policy is the cheapest on the evaluation window: 06:00 + 12:00. 18:00 is not used.
Load has no official forecast; it is estimated from history. PV uses 附件3.

forecast.pv_interpolation: anchor at issue-time observed PV (00:00 uses yesterday last slot), linear interp of 24 hourly forecasts onto slot-end hours, clip ≥ 0

rolling.horizon_at_update: next block only, not remaining day
rolling.terminal_soc: pinned to 00:00 planned SOC at block end

plan.day_ahead: 144 planned purchase slots per day, written to result3 sheet 1
plan.battery_schedule: same splicing as final purchase; SOC rebuilt from 6000 with η=0.9

results.note_june: June rolling 1,470,476 > static 1,452,964; rolling loses that month.
